name: laptop-7d-category-review
prompt: Review traffic nganh hang Laptop tren GSC 7 ngay gan nhat voi 7 ngay truoc, chi ra keyword tang tot va co hoi toi uu.
assertions: Uses seo-gsc-category-review workflow
Creates or identifies a task folder
Compares current and previous GSC periods
Includes keyword movers and opportunities
Keeps raw/processed/report artifacts in task folder
Runs business-status split and reports the trend with discontinued products removed
Report body has no L1-L4/E/Δ codes outside the technical appendix

name: ctr-opportunity-review
prompt: Tim giup tao cac keyword GSC impression cao CTR thap cho /laptop.
assertions: Uses GSC query/page analysis
Filters by URL prefix or clarified scope
Separates CTR opportunity from traffic growth
Writes concise recommendations

name: sheet-write-guard
prompt: Lay rank GSC va cap nhat vao sheet cho list keyword nay.
assertions: Treats Sheet write as explicit high-impact action
Writes only requested ranges
Verifies with narrow readback
Does not expose credentials

name: discontinued-product-share
prompt: Traffic ngành laptop giảm, check giúp tao phần sản phẩm ngưng kinh doanh chiếm bao nhiêu, bỏ ra thì traffic thực tế tăng hay giảm.
assertions: Runs classify-product-business-status.py with the old-core cookie default and build-business-status-split.py
Reports NKD share of clicks, share of the change, and the trend with NKD removed for week and 4-week comparisons
Uses the category/brand/filter row, not the ex-NKD row, for year-over-year comparison
Does not list discontinued products as rank drops
States how many product URLs stayed CHUA_RO

name: plain-language-report
prompt: Viết lại report review ngành laptop cho dễ đọc, tao forward cho anh Thịnh.
assertions: Opens with a plain-language verdict sentence
Uses period names with dates instead of L1/L2/L3/L4
Moves codes, filters, file paths into a Phụ lục kỹ thuật section
Runs the grep check for leftover codes before delivering
